title: A failed source fails what depends on it
statement: When a text or specification fails a check, carry the failure to every lesson, item, chart and piece of feedback built on it.
detail: The reading project's review packet for science, social-studies and passage integrity ends its work order by propagating any upstream failure through every declared dependent lesson, item, chart and feedback object (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/handoffs/g3-reading-v2-feedback-2026-07-16/science-passage-agent.md`). It also requires a list of stale dependents after every failed upstream specification (the same file).

evidence.quote: 6. Propagate any upstream failure through every declared dependent lesson, item, chart, and feedback object.
A stale-dependency list after every failed upstream specification.
A node is quoting passage text that no longer exists. Rewriting a passage means updating everything that points at it.
Replacing readings alone would invalidate many current exact-evidence questions, vocabulary bindings, models and narration.
The text says that London is "cold and dark," and the children "could not sleep" at bedtime because they are bored
being cached by sha1(VOICE|STYLE|text), it shipped identically into every node that speaks that sentence
For video, a check-8 FAIL on a still is a blocker on the film until a re-render clears it.
